claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. At actual length N enumerate primes2<=k<=N, r=ceil(N/k) and r-1 with r>=3,k>r+1, m=min(N,rk), ignored p=N-m, and2<=t<r. Use d=H+E0+1 from disperser.md Sections12--13, B=t(t+3)/2<=d<m, and choose the minimum(4p+8d-4B-3,k,t,p) including the zero option(4N,0,0,0). Construct Q_k by the supplied deterministic prime-degree specialization of Shoup in field.md and irreducible_prime(k), ignore p actual input bits, and evaluate the descending-power order-t symmetric polynomial on the remaining m bits over F2[Z]/Q_k with zero padding. No field-polynomial bits or advice are inputs.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This ONE fixed total deterministic-field language is in uniform P, hence NP with empty witnesses. The supplied prime-degree constructor, PRIME-DEGREE coefficient-isolation/zero-deficit theorem and full-B2 elimination establish C_B2(F_N)>=4N-L_N at EVERY actual integer N>=0 for the exact total selector in family.py. Sections8--10 prove for EVERY integer N>=0 that L_N<=(114905/10000)N^(4/5), hence C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(114905/10000)N^(4/5). The supplied classical nu8kernel and two further rational kernels, checked on every30030period cell and their tails, prove simultaneously proved explicit psi estimates and a prime in(x,(21/20)x] for EVERY real x>=2^260. Sections9--10 discharge all guards, infinite N>=2^435, zero0..195, all25041finite rows for196..2^35-1 and a fully reproduced6066-entry prime chain covering EVERY real h in2^18..2^262 for the ENTIRE middle2^35<=N<2^435. Each prime has independent trial division or a supplied proved Proth witness. Universal transfers are proved, not sample extrapolation. Consequently for every epsilon>0, at all sufficiently large integer N, C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)N. The four six-entry tuples compare numeric certified losses only. No prior verdict, floating-point optimum or unproved nonstandard external theorem is a premise.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

claims: For every ODD PRIME k>=3, the exact irreducible_prime(k) algorithm in family.py terminates in polynomial time in k and outputs a monic irreducible binary polynomial of degree k. field.md supplies the complete prime-degree construction and proof, including binary factor extraction, cyclotomic nonresidue lifting, Kummer extension and trace descent. This specializes a known Shoup construction and does not claim a new general irreducible-construction algorithm.

The complete finite certified losses(original,weighted,positive-exact,zero-deficit,compressed,new) are(1461,1437,1429,1413,1393,1257) at N=500,(2533,2493,2485,2485,2465,2265) at N=1000,(4513,4449,4433,4417,4397,4061) at N=2000,and(16809,16601,16577,16521,16501,15365) at N=10000. These compare certified losses, not actual optimal circuit sizes.

For EVERY integer N>=0 the SAME fixed total uniform P family satisfies C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(114905/10000)N^(4/5). Sections8--10 supply the complete nu8and two rational floor schemes, power-error and improved prime-interval proof, infinite tail, zero range, 25041 checked finite intervals and6066prime-chain entries with proved witnesses. All real/integer coverage transfers are supplied proofs.
